title: Formal Certification of Real Equiangular Lines in Dimensions 18-20, Leech Evaluation Codes, and Sharp Fixed-Angle Bounds
abstract: We present a machine-checked formal verification and zero-float rational certificate suite (EQUIANGULAR-D18-20-CERT-1.0) auditing the algebraic, coding-theoretic, lattice-embedding, and fixed-angle theorems of Djaljapayan, Liao, and Yu (arXiv:2611.34855v1, developed with GPT-6), which settle N(18)=57, N(19)=72, and N(20)=90 and establish sharp fixed-angle intervals N_{1/q}(d)=d+7 (q>=319) and N_{1/q}(d)=d+23 (q>=5599). Our artifact comprises an 18-theorem constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier with exact rational LDL^T PSD and rank certification, 16 canonical JSON certificates (C01-C16), and 32 unit and forgery-rejection tests covering Proposition 2.3's 57-line R^18 configuration, Lemma 1.3 paired even-lattice embeddings, the extended binary Golay code G_24 and Leech evaluation-code weights (Lemma 4.8, Proposition 4.9, nested sharp sections 276/176/126/90), exact integer-squaring verification of Theorem 5.1 intervals and Seidel-block Gram matrices, Theorem 5.2 symmetric Paley conference matrices, and Proposition 5.3 cosine-1/7 maxima.
